recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition album cover featuring a top section of cream-colored paper with bold, condensed Western-style typography and a bottom section showing a candid photograph of four men in suits behind a chain-link fence, separated by a jagged, torn-paper edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn paper edge dividing the text-heavy top from the photographic bottom
Repetition of verticality in the condensed letterforms and the standing figures
Contrast between the clean cream background and the dark, textured photographic grain
Warm color harmony between the red-brown text and the sepia-toned image
coreInvariants: Jagged horizontal tear across the upper third
Ultra-condensed slab-serif or western-style display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men occupy the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled to mid-torso; typography dominates the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, red-brown title text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title, moves down to the secondary text line, crosses the torn edge, and settles on the faces of the band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cream-colored negative space in the top header area provides breathing room for the dense typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the header and low value contrast in the photographic section.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and muted reds

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight internal curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular bullet points used as word separators
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale-based hierarchy using the same font family in different sizes.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the western slab-serif aesthetic and condensed proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s photograph of four men in suits standing behind a chain-link fence, sepia-toned and grainy. The top third of the image should be a solid cream-colored paper texture with a jagged, horizontal torn-paper edge separating it from the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, ultra-condensed western slab-serif text in a deep red-brown color on the cream background. Use circular bullets to separate words.

verificationChecks: Is the torn edge jagged and realistic?
Is the typography ultra-condensed and slab-serif?
Does the photo have a 1960s film grain and sepia tint?
Is the chain-link fence visible in the foreground of the photo?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the torn edge unless intended
Verify the cream background has subtle paper texture
Check that the fence does not obscure the faces too much
Confirm the typography feels 'heavy' and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cream Header with Torn Edge] + [Ultra-Condensed Western Type] + [Grainy Sepia Group Portrait] + [Foreground Texture Overlay].
